# Independent 3D picture color-transfer controls

Original textless OOXML and RGB artwork generated by
`tools/picture_3d_color_transfer_fixture.py`; repository license applies.
No user-template content, third-party renderer, font program or new dependency
is included. Generate into fresh directories:

```
python tools/picture_3d_color_transfer_fixture.py OUTPUT_RGB
python tools/picture_3d_color_transfer_fixture.py OUTPUT_GRAY --grayscale
python tools/picture_3d_color_transfer_fixture.py OUTPUT_MATTE_GRAY --grayscale --matte
```

Each source has three square 160pt pictures: omitted material/threePt,
warmMatte/threePt and warmMatte/twoPt, with orthographicFront camera,
10pt extrusion and 2pt unlit contour. The source PNG contains either 64 RGB
swatches or all 256 grayscale values. Numeric positioning avoids a text/font
layout dependency. No document text is present.

Native page-range metafiles were captured by
`tools/capture_retained_picture_resize.ps1` after exact-file opening in the reference application.
`native/capture.json` guards source hash, unchanged bytes, Saved state and view.
These normalized imports had Saved=false before and after capture. Earlier
captures failing the Saved-state guard are excluded. Metafiles are compressed
with gzip (mtime=0); capture hashes apply to the decompressed original bytes.

Regenerate measurements into a new output file:

```
python tools/record_picture_3d_transfer.py tests/fixtures/picture-3d-transfer/rgb64 NEW_RGB.json
python tools/record_picture_3d_transfer.py tests/fixtures/picture-3d-transfer/gray256 NEW_GRAY.json
python tests/emfplus_image_objects_test.py
```

The recorder reconstructs bounded EMF+ compressed-image objects without playing
metafiles or inspecting fonts. It checks PNG CRC/dimensions, image hashes and
25 flat opaque pixels per swatch. The nine references contain 1,728 swatches.
They certify encoded front-face RGB only, not native positioning, page geometry,
antialiasing, screen/PDF equivalence or whole-document agreement.

## Observations and unresolved rendering

Omitted material and explicit warmMatte produce identical colors in both grids.
For RGB(20,80,190), the native threePt reference emits (26,88,202); the current shader emits
(27,89,204). The exact-color tests have nine fixed expected failures;
these failures are known fidelity gaps, not completed rendering support.

All 256 twoPt grays match nearest-even rounding of `63/64*x+6` (with byte
clamping). This observation does not establish a lighting algorithm for other
normals, view directions, materials or rigs. ThreePt does not match nearest-even
`133/128*x+5`: input192 is native205, while that candidate gives204. The alternative
`53/51*x+5` fails inputs115,166,217. No fitted constants have been put in the painter.

MS-OI29500 §§2.1.1274(c), 2.1.1334(b) specify the light/material presets already
used by the shader; they do not establish the observed final raster arithmetic.
The inspected release is 2026-08-18. Exact raster agreement remains open.

## Native continuation variation

Each captured image uses multiple EMF+ Object records. The reference application keeps the C bit set
even on the last chunk, whose concatenated bytes complete TotalObjectSize.
[MS-EMFPLUS §2.3.5.1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-emfplus/978404e2-c994-4e60-bade-cb6ab78e7ffc)
describes a final chunk with C clear. This independently authored control records
the difference explicitly. The diagnostic reader completes at the declared
total and retains the actual last-C flag; it rejects incomplete/over-budget or
conflicting totals. A final clear-C continuation form remains unsupported by
this bounded diagnostic, rather than interpreted without a verified control.
This is not a change to the application's EMF playback.

## Matte material control

`matte-gray256` retains the default warmMatte/threePt first page and changes
pages2/3 to matte/threePt and matte/twoPt. The first page reproduces the earlier
warm grayscale values exactly. Native black is zero for both matte rigs,
confirming no specular highlight. All 256 native matte grays match nearest-even
`133/128*x` (threePt, byte clamped) and `63/64*x` (twoPt). These empirical
front-face mappings are not production shader coefficients.

The importer now passes explicit matte to the existing shader, instead of
rejecting it. Default/explicit warmMatte retains its previous scene structure.
Material metadata survives text edits, exact undo and retained resizing. The
known final raster rounding gap still applies; other unsupported materials
remain protected.
